name: Josianne
source:
Josianne is a beautiful French woman who works as a waitress at a fancy restaurant situated in a natural cave near the ocean. She is married to Marcel who works as the Maître d' at the same restaurant. They are first encountered in the background when the protagonist takes Allison on a romantic date to the restaurant they work at. 

Later they are encountered again in the park and this time they have a proposition for the protagonist. It turns out that Marcel cannot get an erection without watching his woman have sex with another man! (And he apparently needs multiple times to have full effect.) They want the protagonist to have sex with Josianne while Marcel watches. 

Josianne is reluctant to the whole idea, as it turns out she is a virgin. She has not even seen a penis! (The protagonist finds this surprising, even if they never have had sex, Josianne and Marcel have been married for four years and they have never seen each other naked in that time?) The protagonist calms her and assures her that they will stop as soon as she feels uncomfortable. She feels better but still needs some time to come to terms with it. They agree to arrage a later date.
